See [CJPTU9FV]: 627-628 (PHAG 177). This two-folio work appears in Vol. III, No. 61, on fols. 307a4-308b4 of Phag mo gru pa'i bka' 'bum, compiled by Kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po in 1507 in 'Bri gung mthil. 
NGMPP E 3169/1, E3170/1, E3171/1. Photographed from the private library of Drikung Khyabgon Chetsang Rinpoche.
Its colophon reads: dam pa'i zhu ba nyi shu pa || dge slong rdo rje rgyal po yis || bshes gnyen phya pa chos seng la || gdams pa zab mos zhu ba phul || bhavantu |
name: dam pa'i zhu ba nyi shu pa
